profileName: Enterprise Service Landscape and Dependency Impact View

cases.input: A failed database has current declared functional dependencies to three services, each with licensed propagation.
cases.expect: The view reports three evidence-backed impact exposures and preserves every source edge.

cases.input: A fourth service has only a stale observed flow to the failed database.
cases.expect: The service is exposed-unconfirmed; stale evidence is visible and no current dependency is asserted.

cases.input: A fifth service shares a rack but its correlation edge has no failure-propagation license.
cases.expect: The view reports a common-mode candidate without direct service impact.

cases.input: Part of the tenant graph has no current completeness declaration and traversal finds no further edges.
cases.expect: The result is incomplete rather than no further impact.

cases.input: A deployment manifest declares an instance healthy while monitoring is absent, and the view emits one healthy current state.
cases.expect: The view is rejected because desired and observed state were collapsed and absence was treated as health.

cases.input: Two identically named services in different tenants are merged without authoritative identity evidence.
cases.expect: The merge is blocked by tenant isolation.

cases.input: A graph traversal creates a new incident record from an exposure result.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; incidents remain externally mastered and the landscape returns only a projection.
